sonnet.problem: This true/false statement re-asks the fact card 8 just covered, that the seven thousand had not bowed to Baal. It only repeats the card before it.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: Card 9 quotes the line and cuts it off right before 'to this very day.' Card 10 then asks the baker to supply the next words of that line. These words can't be reasoned out, and the wrong answers are filler guesses ('For forty years', 'For seven years').
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The statement says David's line 'echoes' the earlier quote. That claims a connection between the two passages that the text never states. It also only restates what cards 9 and 11 already told.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
